FINISHING OPTIONS

How Does a Finish Change the Same Box?

Explore the tactile and visual details that make a presentation feel right for your brand.

FOIL

Foil stamping

Metallic accents for a logo, fine rule or carefully placed artwork.

UV

Spot UV

A gloss highlight over selected areas of a printed surface.

RELIEF

Embossing & debossing

A raised or recessed impression that adds a tactile brand detail.

TOUCH

Soft-touch lamination

A smooth, muted surface treatment for a softer hand feel.

PAPER

Textured papers

Linen-like, natural or finely grained papers with a distinctive finish.

PRINT

Custom color & print

Coordinate the outer wrap, interior and supporting brand pieces.

A CLEARER WAY TO COMPARE

Custom Packaging Support vs. Template-Only Tools

Choose a process that matches the structure, presentation and order requirements of your project.

Template-based ordering

  • Preset structuresBegin with the formats and sizes included in a catalog.
  • Self-service artworkPlace artwork within an existing template and print area.
  • Standard optionsChoose from the material and finishing combinations shown.
  • Defined fulfillmentReview the listed packing and shipping arrangements.
PROJECT-SPECIFIC

FORME Packaging custom projects

  • A product-specific structureReview size, opening direction, fit and insert requirements.
  • Coordinated brandingConnect the paper, print, ribbon and interior details.
  • Physical sample reviewCheck the real product in the proposed construction.
  • A written specificationConfirm the agreed scope, quantities and production plan.

HOW IT WORKS

How Do You Order Custom Gift Boxes?
Four Simple Steps

A clear sequence from the initial product brief to sample approval and delivery planning.

01

Share your requirements

Start with your product and the experience you want to create.

What to confirm
  • Product dimensions and weight
  • Preferred structure and quantity
  • Logo or artwork references
  • Color, finish and delivery needs
02

Review design & quotation

Bring the structure, materials and finishing into a clear written specification.

What to confirm
  • Box layout and opening direction
  • Paper and insert options
  • Artwork and finishing scope
  • Project-specific price and schedule
03

Approve a physical sample

Check the presentation with the actual product before production approval.

What to confirm
  • Fit and internal clearance
  • Paper texture and printed color
  • Closure and opening experience
  • Signed-off final specification
04

Production & delivery

Agree on the production checkpoints, packing method and delivery arrangement.

What to confirm
  • Production schedule
  • Inspection checkpoints
  • Outer carton packing
  • Freight plan and destination
Start with Your Requirements →
COMMON PACKAGING QUESTIONS

Packaging Know-How

Useful starting points for comparing formats, planning quantities and preparing a project.

What packaging formats are available?

Browse magnetic and lift-off gift boxes, drawers, tubes, bags, specialty shapes, color printed corrugated shipping cartons, printed mailers and white-card folding cartons.

What is the minimum order quantity?

Minimum quantities depend on the box format, dimensions, paper and finishing method. Tell us your expected quantity so the specification and order requirements can be reviewed together.

How long does production take?

The schedule depends on sampling, material availability, finishing and quantity. Confirm the sample approval date, production window and shipping plan in the final quotation.

Can you create a custom insert?

Provide the dimensions and weight of each item. Paperboard, fabric-lined and foam insert directions can then be reviewed for presentation and support.

BEFORE YOU ORDER

Questions We Hear Most Often

Practical answers about artwork, samples, quantities, finishing and delivery.

Minimum quantities depend on the box format, dimensions, paper and finishing method. Tell us your expected quantity so the specification and order requirements can be reviewed together.

The schedule depends on sampling, material availability, finishing and quantity. Confirm the sample approval date, production window and shipping plan in the final quotation.

A physical sample helps confirm product fit, paper feel, opening behavior and print. Agree on sampling scope, cost and timing before proceeding.

Share your logo files, color references and preferred artwork. A physical proof or approved sample should be used as the final production reference.

Foil stamping, embossing, debossing, spot UV, soft-touch lamination and textured papers are possible directions. The appropriate process is confirmed for your chosen material and artwork.

Payment arrangements, sampling charges and production milestones are confirmed in the project quotation. Request a written breakdown before approving an order.

Share the destination, required arrival date and packing requirements. Confirm freight options, responsibilities and any local import requirements with the final shipping plan.

Browse magnetic and lift-off gift boxes, drawers, tubes, bags, specialty shapes, color printed corrugated shipping cartons, printed mailers and white-card folding cartons.

Price depends on size, construction, material, print coverage, finish and quantity. The planning calculator is illustrative; a final quotation uses your confirmed specification.

Paperboard inserts, kraft papers and separable components can be explored. Confirm exact material composition and any environmental claims for your project.

Provide the dimensions and weight of each item. Paperboard, fabric-lined and foam insert directions can then be reviewed for presentation and support.

Custom Gift Box FAQ

What packaging formats are available?

Browse magnetic and lift-off gift boxes, drawers, tubes, bags, specialty shapes, color printed corrugated shipping cartons, printed mailers and white-card folding cartons.

What is the minimum order quantity?

Minimum quantities depend on the box format, dimensions, paper and finishing method. Tell us your expected quantity so the specification and order requirements can be reviewed together.

How much will a custom box cost?

Price depends on size, construction, material, print coverage, finish and quantity. The planning calculator is illustrative; a final quotation uses your confirmed specification.

How long does production take?

The schedule depends on sampling, material availability, finishing and quantity. Confirm the sample approval date, production window and shipping plan in the final quotation.

Can I request paper-led packaging options?

Paperboard inserts, kraft papers and separable components can be explored. Confirm exact material composition and any environmental claims for your project.
